rollup_keys_note: Other negative keys are real rows and stay in: -10000 (group-level Amortization adjustment, P&L), -20001 / -20002 / -20003 (retained earnings, translation reserve, profit after tax, balance sheet).
pl_l6_note: Kantata's COA L6 is account-level detail (about 240 lines a month, which the connector cuts off at 24 months). The pl query keeps L6 only under these L5 lines, where the template needs it (Sales / Marketing, Engineering / Product), and sums the rest to L5.
subsidiary_scope_note: The exclusion applies to FINANCE_ANALYTICS (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and to GTM bookings. ARR_ANALYTICS, GTM pipeline and the FINANCE_ANALYTICS revolver (Finance's manual REVOLVER table, related to no other table) have no subsidiary dimension: they cover every entity as stored.
exclude_accounts_note: Kantata's five internal test accounts, excluded from ARR, customers, recurring bookings and pipeline in every run. Matched by 18-character Salesforce account ID only, never by name: real customers whose names contain 'test' stay in. IDs the user names in a request are added on top. FINANCE_ANALYTICS has no Salesforce account, so the P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and revolver still include them.
revolver_drawn_note: Drawn Revolver = the FINANCE_ANALYTICS balance sheet month-end balance (ENDING_BALANCE_CONVERTED) of ACCOUNT_NUMBER 280360 (Alliance Bernstein Revolver, under Senior Debt). Validated 2026-11-24: one account and entity, every month Oct-24 to Oct-26, converted = unconverted (USD), 18.16mn to Aug-25 then 17.21mn. The other revolver accounts (280370 Sixth Street Revolver, 280903 PIK Interest Revolver) are 0 today and not included.
